title: They work but are very odd and not that stable.
text:
They work but are very odd and not that stable.. It does hold a load of dry laundry but don't use it to transfer to dryer. They hook together and wet laundry is just too much for them. Also they kinda look cheap like something you would find on Wish.

Overall not worth the price. Go for something that does not collapse so it doesn't collapse with your clothes in it. I'm going to stick them in our spare rooms for visitors to use.
